name: USWF Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top prize, first awarded on a controversial triangle-match finish involving a lookalike twin swap.

name: USWF Television Championship
epitaph: The fed's own secondary prize, first decided in a 27-man battle royal and immediately stolen by a wrestler who had hidden under the ring for the whole match.

name: USWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own tag-team prize, first awarded at its own first pay-per-view.
